title: JWT 'none' Algorithm Authentication Bypass
description: Authentication token verification routine accepts unverified tokens when header specifies alg: none.
security_invariant: Only cryptographic HMAC-SHA256 signatures with matching secret are accepted; alg 'none' must be rejected.
expected_vulnerable_behavior: Tokens with "alg": "none" and empty signature bypass verification and authenticate as admin.
required_secure_behavior: Tokens with "alg": "none" raise PermissionError; only authentic HS256 tokens pass verification.
